items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Who? ... [INTERVIEWER] He said Ernie Wilkins, but you said it was a white guy… [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah, a big white guy played, he was from California. He had a band out here at one time…

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to write arrangements and he even played in Basie‘s when Basie wasn‘t there, a couple times Basie had something to do, and we would play the gig with him, he piano player.
